article.title: Tired of Tab Chaos? Ideon is Your New Visual Workspace for Projects!

title: Tired of Tab Chaos? Ideon is Your New Visual Workspace for Projects!
published: True
tags: project, visual, selfhosted, developer

## Quick Summary: 📝
Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that allows users to organize projects, notes, and tasks on an infinite canvas. It replaces traditional folder structures with spatial organization, enabling real-time collaboration and historical tracking of workspace evolution.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace for organizing all project assets on an infinite canvas.

* ✅ It allows spatial organization of Git repositories, issues, notes, links, and files, reducing context switching.

* ✅ Features live integrations with GitHub, GitLab, and other platforms, real-time multiplayer collaboration, and 'Time Travel' for historical views.

* ✅ Offers complete data ownership and privacy due to its self-hosted nature, with easy setup using Docker.

* ✅ Transforms abstract project structures into a tangible, visual map, enhancing understanding and team workflow.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 559
* 🍴 **Forks:** 23
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 14


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ TypeScript


Hey fellow developers! Ever feel like your project context is scattered across a dozen browser tabs, multiple tools, and endless folder hierarchies? You've got your GitHub repo open, a separate tab for design notes, another for issues, and maybe a local markdown file for your thoughts. It's a constant juggle, right? Well, what if there was a way to bring *everything* together onto a single, interactive map? Prepare to say goodbye to context switching headaches, because I've stumbled upon a GitHub project that's genuinely changing the game: Ideon. Ideon isn't just another project management tool; it's a self-hosted visual workspace that redefines how you interact with your projects. Imagine an infinite canvas where you can literally *place* your Git repositories, individual issues, design mockups, markdown notes, links, and even files. The magic here is the spatial organization – what's visually close on your canvas is conceptually related in your project. No more abstract folders; you build a living, breathing map of your work. This means you get an immediate, birds-eye view of your entire project context. Need to see an issue related to a specific code module? Just place them next to each other! Ideon offers live integrations with popular platforms like GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and Forgejo, allowing you to embed live repository data and issues directly onto your canvas. This isn't just a static image; it's dynamic, updating as your project evolves. But wait, there's more! Ideon supports real-time multiplayer collaboration, so you and your team can work together on the same canvas, seeing each other's changes instantly. Think of it like a collaborative whiteboard, but for your entire development ecosystem. Plus, its 'Time Travel' feature lets you view historical snapshots of your workspace, making it incredibly easy to trace decisions and understand how your project evolved. And the best part? It's completely self-hosted. You own your data, ensuring privacy and control, which is a huge win in today's cloud-centric world. Getting started is a breeze with Docker and Docker Compose, making deployment incredibly straightforward. For any developer tired of the fragmented project experience, Ideon offers a refreshing and intuitive alternative. It transforms abstract project structures into a tangible, visual landscape, making it easier to understand, manage, and collaborate. Seriously, go check out the demo or clone the repo – you'll be amazed at how quickly you can visualize and organize your development world. This is one project you absolutely don't want to miss!
